messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — we need a lightweight plan for Hyperswap routing rollout. customers want lower-cost fallbacks + per-region safety. propose a 4-step canary with per-tenant opt-ins. thoughts?

kai (Eng): +1. propose flags: `ff/hyperswap-enabled`, `ff/hyperswap-region-gate`, `ff/hyperswap-ab`

ajay (SRE): we need clear latency and error SLO gates for each step. suggest: max p95 < 220ms, error rate < 0.5% per 5m window. auto-rollback if breached twice in a 30m window.

megan (Data): add data gates: model-quality regression <= 0.7% composite score (prompt set). run A/B for 48h per step, collect token cost delta and latency.

maria (PM): rollout percentages I suggest: 0.5% (smoke) -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with regional staging: us-east -> eu-west -> ap-southeast. opt-in customers get earlier exposure.

olivia (CS): can we prioritize a small set of paying customers for opt-in? two willing teams: Acme + Bluebird. need a comms checklist.

kai (Eng): implementation notes: route policy will pick variant 'hyperswap-v1' (saves ~15% tokens) and fallback to `hyperswap-fallback-quant` if cache miss high or p95 spike. snippet for rollout hook: ```json
{ "route": "hyperswap-v1", "fallback": "hyperswap-fallback-quant", "sampling": 0.005 }
```

ajay (SRE): add a kill-switch runbook: `ff/hyperswap-enabled = false` triggers immediate traffic shift to `baseline-v2`. SRE-run command: `rollout revert --flag ff/hyperswap-enabled` (bot will run sanity checks).

rollout-bot: scheduled canary checks enabled. will post summary @channel every 15m during steps.

megan (Data): A/B design: A=weight routing (current); B=latency-aware routing (new). Primary metrics: p95 latency, token cost per request, quality regression on 200 eval prompts. Bench thresholds in the doc.

maria (PM): outstanding asks: 1) telemetry dashboards (per-tenant) 2) hook for CS to opt-in customers 3) pre-approved rollback owners + SLAs 4) runbook drafted by EOD Fri. who owns?

kai (Eng): I can do 1 + 2 with help from Olivia. Ajay will own runbook. Megan will own A/B metrics.

olivia (CS): I'll draft the opt-in message and plan customer kickoff calls.

ajay (SRE): noted. I'll add automated remediation to block noisy tenants (per-tenant cap) and a circuit breaker: if cluster CPU > 80% then start shedding hyperswap traffic by 50%.

maria (PM): cool — next steps: Kai to push flag scaffolding and lightweight canary implementation, Ajay to author runbook, Megan to create evaluation set + dashboards, Olivia to coordinate customers. check-in tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
